UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private authenticated player profile and lifetime/weekly stats.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

avatarId.description: Encoded custom avatar identifier (optional, max 64 characters).

googleLinked.description: True for Google-authenticated accounts eligible for the global leaderboard.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public non-PII global leaderboard stats for Google-authenticated players only.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

avatarId.description: Encoded custom avatar identifier (optional, max 64 characters).

googleLinked.description: Must be true so only Google accounts appear on the leaderboard.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

OnlineRoom.title: OnlineRoom
OnlineRoom.description: Shared real-time Ludo multiplayer room, lobby, matchmaking slot, synced authoritative game state, and rematch voting.

roomCode.description: 6-character uppercase alphanumeric room code matching document ID.

hostUid.description: Current room host UID (transfers automatically if host leaves).

timedDurationSeconds.description: Match clock duration in seconds for Timed mode (300 or 600).

status.description: Lifecycle phase of the multiplayer room.

publicMatchmaking.description: True when open for random matchmaking, false for private friend rooms.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (max 4) of joined human player UIDs.

seats.description: Bounded list (max 4) of seat maps containing color, uid, nickname, controllerType, botDifficulty, connected, botTakeover, consecutiveMisses, lastHeartbeatMs, rematchVoted.

diceSeed.description: Deterministic room entropy seed combined with server turnStartedAt timestamp for fair dice rolls.

turnSeq.description: Monotonic state transition sequence for synced animations and conflict prevention.

lastActionType.description: Last synced action type (NONE, START, ROLL, MOVE, SHIELD, DOUBLE_DICE, BOMB, TIMEOUT, BOT_TAKEOVER, REMATCH).

lastActionSummary.description: Short human-readable summary of the last action.

lastMovedColor.description: Color of the token animated in the last move.

lastMovedTokenId.description: Token ID (0-3) or -1 when no token moved.

lastMovedFromProgress.description: Starting progress of the last animated token.

lastMovedToProgress.description: Destination progress of the last animated token.

gameStateMap.description: Native Firestore map representing the authoritative Ludo GameState.

turnStartedAt.description: Server timestamp of the active turn start for synced 30s countdown and fair dice entropy.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

MatchHistoryRecord.title: MatchHistoryRecord
MatchHistoryRecord.description: Private per-user completed match history entry stored under /users/{userId}/matchHistory/{matchId}.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching parent userId.

onlineMatch.description: True if played online, false if local pass-and-play or vs bots.

roomCode.description: 6-character room code for online matches, or empty string for local matches.

winnerName.description: Display nickname of the match winner.

winnerColor.description: PlayerColor enum name of the match winner.

won.description: Whether the owner won the match.

rank.description: Owner finishing placement (1-4, or 0 for pass-and-play).

turnsPlayed.description: Total turns played in the match.

capturesMade.description: Opponent captures made by the user in this match.

tokensHome.description: Tokens sent home by the user in this match (0-4).

powerUpsUsed.description: Power-ups activated by the user in this match.

players.description: Bounded list (max 4) of per-player result maps (nickname, color, isBot, rank, capturesMade, tokensHome, powerUpsUsed, score).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profiles isolated per authenticated UID.

/users/{userId}/matchHistory/{matchId}.description: Private per-user completed match history records.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Global leaderboard stats for Google-authenticated players.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Online multiplayer rooms for friend codes, matchmaking, live turn state, and rematch voting.
